comparison.objective: Clamp a hanging folder around a packet and hook all four rod ends onto frame rails; candidate configures a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually pinch an articulated folder, retain loose contents, and align four suspension points versus threaded tool use and torque coordination.
comparison.success_condition: All four hooks seated, folder suspended, packet retained upright, hands at least 80 mm clear, and state stable for one second.
comparison.reason: Suspended multi-point placement with content retention is materially different from stop adjustment and locknut verification.
